subject: Copywriting
title: The PS Line Secret
description: A quick win: understand The PS Line Secret.

hook.text: Eye-tracking studies show the PS line is the second-most-read part of an email, right after the subject line.

buildup.text: The PS was a necessity in typed letters—corrections added at the bottom. In email, it's a strategic weapon.

discovery.text: Direct response marketers load the PS with urgency, bonuses, or a restatement of the core benefit.

twist.text: A PS works because it looks personal and afterthought-like. The reader's guard drops. It feels less like selling.

climax.text: Test a strong PS in your next email: restate the offer, add a deadline, or reveal a bonus. Watch clicks jump.

punchline.text: The PS is the second-most-read line. Use it to close the deal.

quiz.question: What is the most-read part of an email after the subject line?
